title: This app makes $2m/year using this ridiculously easy strategy
description:

In this episode, I sit down to explore how a simple app development strategy is earning over $2M per year. Whether you're passionate about mobile app development, just starting out with coding, or thinking about launching your first app, this conversation breaks down everything you need to know.

We get into the real-world process of how to make an app, from idea to execution, covering both app development for beginners and advanced concepts like full stack development. If you're wondering how to create an app, this episode gives you the tools and mindset.

I also dive into the structure behind a winning business model, share proven business ideas, and highlight new business ideas worth exploring. Whether you're aiming to become a software developer, already in software development, or just interested in the business side of apps, you’ll get valuable insights.

This isn’t just about programming—it’s about how to think like a creator and build something scalable. If you’ve been researching how to develop an app, want to learn about the future of app development, or need solid app ideas, this episode is for you.

From breaking into app development to scaling your own app, we’re covering all the angles that make apps work—and make money.
